content:
International Data Migration Day isn't real yet.
But after this episode, it should be!

Episode 4 of the Data in 10 Podcast by binary10 drops TOMORROW!! 🎙️

This one has the story behind how Jamie and Steve created a whole holiday on May 23rd 👇

→ Their first project: hotel stays, late shifts, and somehow still keeping the mood alive
 → Jamie's near heart attack when he thought he wiped all production data
 → Why data migration pros deserve their moment in the limelight 
→ See you next Tuesday story!

🎧 Out tomorrow on Spotify, YouTube, and Apple Podcasts!

Drop a comment if you think International Data Migration Day deserves to be official!

Also, lastly do you work within the IT department in the public sector? WE NEED YOUR HELP!
We are putting together an industry report on public sector data readiness, and we want your real-world insights.
Take our quick 60 sec survey here: https://lnkd.in/evvPfui6
comment: Data migration deserves more visibility because the hardest part is rarely moving bytes; it’s preserving trust, lineage, and business continuity when those bytes become the new source of truth.
